hooks.command: if [ -d "$(pwd)/docs" ]; then if [ -f "$(pwd)/docs/.jdm-indexed" ]; then echo 'jdocmunch: docs indexed. Use search_sections, get_toc, get_section for doc exploration. Reuse anchors/facts after reading a doc once; do not reread full docs unless changed or necessary.'; else echo 'jdocmunch: docs/ exists but not indexed. Run: roborepo index docs docs/ before broad doc exploration when practical.'; fi; fi

_descriptions.RoboRepo: documentation index reminder: Checks whether the current docs folder has an index and suggests documentation-index tools or indexing it.
